final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area threshold because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.
User wants energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1-A4, B and C. The energy_score_class column cannot isolate C (score 3 covers B-E), so energy_class is used.
User explicitly wants a location near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution.

A university student residence is inherently tied to universities and schools, so nearby education services are necessary. Set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75) of the education distribution.
